inventory_method: Published package metadata plus visual same-sheet title block inspection; matching project names or bid text alone do not establish a drawing revision pair.

confirmed_drawing_pairs.scope: Same Control Center No.1 one-line drawing, known added transition section. Already visually inspected during prior development; cannot be reported unseen.

potential_pairs_not_claimed_as_accuracy.reason: 2022 specification versus 2024 reissued bid specification, not an independently labelled same-drawing engineering revision pair.
Original and rebid invitation documents plus one separate drawing; no two verified drawing issues.
Bid addenda contain dated sheets, but no same-sheet before/after ground truth has been independently established.
Other repeated pages and reviewer copies occur in binder, but are not counted as independent revision pairs without same drawing/title-block confirmation and full change labels.

limitation: Do not report one known development change as general revision accuracy. Pilot request must include every dated drawing revision and returned reviewer package.
